svg.title: Actseal: does this frozen action policy meet its declared risk and coverage limits?
svg.desc: actseal · frozen decision policies · risk and coverage · offline replay. Does this frozen action policy meet its declared risk and coverage limits? Freeze the policy, run it once against labelled cases, bound the errors among accepted actions, seal the evidence, replay it with no model call. Evidence card: PREREGISTERED LIVE AUDIT · 639 VERIFICATION CASES · THRESHOLD 0.80. ACT 580 of 639, errors 24. Fixed benchmark; unreleased producer. risk [0.0250, 0.0639] vs limit 0.05 · coverage [0.879, 0.932]. VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE (exit 2) → replay requires archived producer d3edbab. docs/results/jev-audit-2026-10-08 · neither PASS nor BLOCK is claimed.
